name: Find my next customers
description: Find and rank companies that match your ideal customer.

fields.label: What do your ideal customers do?

limitations: Company search returns a bounded page, normally up to 10 companies. This is not an exhaustive market list.
Enrichment fields and employee estimates are source claims. Registry verification of every company is not included.
output: A ranked shortlist of companies, their websites, available employee estimates, and reasons they fit your target.
answer_instructions: Return a ranked prospect shortlist with company, website, location, available employee range, fit reason and evidence. Keep web candidates separate when identity cannot be matched.

name: New customer onboarding check
description: Check a new business customer before onboarding.

fields.label: Company registration number
fields.help: KVK: 8 digits; UK: 8 characters; France: 9-digit SIREN.

checks: VAT validity and available identity match when provided
limitations: A sanctions name match needs review; no match is not a compliance certification.
Domain age does not prove legitimacy.
output: An onboarding checklist with company details, discrepancies, possible sanctions matches, and items for review.
answer_instructions: Return an onboarding checklist with supported findings, discrepancies, possible matches and items for manual review. Do not claim a legal compliance decision.

vies: VIES names and addresses depend on national availability.

name: Competitor and pricing comparison
description: Compare published pricing, features and commercial terms.

fields.label: What matters in this comparison?
fields.placeholder: Team pricing, API access and cancellation terms

limitations: Only publicly returned pages are compared. Missing pricing remains unknown.
Currencies, billing periods and usage assumptions must be comparable before ranking cost.
output: A comparison of published prices, features, and terms, with the main differences and sources.
answer_instructions: Return a comparison report, the main differences and a recommendation tied to the supplied criteria. Cite each price and commercial term; never invent hidden plans.

name: Find relevant tenders
description: Find procurement notices and assess their fit.
limitations: TenderNed results may include historical and awarded notices. Only explicitly current notices can be described as open.
This retrieves bounded result pages and does not submit a bid.
output: A prioritized shortlist of relevant procurement notices, available dates, and questions to resolve before bidding.

inputs.web.source_search_query: Official procurement notices for {topic} in {market}. Give original notice links, publication type and dates; identify historical awards.

answer_instructions: Return a prioritized shortlist of notices with buyer, publication type, available dates, fit reason, source URL and questions to resolve before bidding.

name: Find potential subsidies
description: Find Dutch and EU funding programmes for your project.

fields.label: Project country
fields.help: Dutch RVO descriptions are included only for projects in the Netherlands.

limitations: EU records may be historical. Eligibility, deadlines and open status must be supported by current official evidence.
output: A funding shortlist with programme details, source links, and eligibility questions to check.

inputs.web.source_search_query: Official current funding programmes for {topic} projects in {country}. Include programme links, published eligibility and dates; distinguish historical schemes.

answer_instructions: Return a funding shortlist with programme, fit reason, source links, available dates and eligibility questions. Explicitly label status unknown when it cannot be confirmed.

rvo: RVO searches only the first 50 public descriptions and can include historical schemes. No match does not mean no funding exists.

name: Property pre-check
description: Check a Dutch address, building, planning and soil signals.
limitations: Select the correct address if the source returns multiple candidates.
Map features do not establish current building rights. No soil-map feature is not proof of clean soil.
This does not supply ownership, valuation, a full soil report or a structural survey.
output: A property checklist with building details, planning and soil signals, official notices, and follow-up questions.
answer_instructions: Return a property screening checklist, factual building details, planning and soil signals, relevant notices, source links and follow-up questions. Keep absence of evidence separate from a passed check.

name: Who is behind this company?
description: Trace UK officers, controllers and available corporate parents.

fields.label: Legal Entity Identifier
fields.help: Optional. Adds direct and ultimate parent relationships from GLEIF.

checks: Direct and ultimate parents when LEI provided
limitations: Companies House significant control is not a universal beneficial ownership register.
Only the named company is screened against sanctions in this run; officers, controllers and parents are not individually screened.
An absent relationship is not evidence that no parent exists.
output: A summary of company officers, significant controllers, and available parent relationships, with sources.
answer_instructions: Return an ownership and control summary with relationship type, person or entity, current or ceased status and evidence. Separate the named-company sanctions result from ownership records.

gleif: GLEIF corporate parents and Companies House significant control describe different relationships.

name: Company financial health snapshot
description: Review available filings, financial data and warning signals.

fields.label: Company registration number
fields.help: KVK: 8 digits; UK: 8 characters; France: 9-digit SIREN.

checks: Insolvency records or alerts where supported
limitations: Coverage differs: NL provides the supported KVK XBRL account subset; UK provides filing history and insolvency records; France provides available Sirenic financials and alerts.
Missing accounts do not prove that a company failed to file. This is a factual snapshot, not a credit rating.
Reuters keyword results can be loosely matched and lack dates.
output: A company health snapshot with reporting dates, available financial figures, warning signals, and headlines.
answer_instructions: Return a factual company health snapshot with reporting dates, available financial figures, supported warning signals, relevant headlines and missing checks. Do not compare unlike periods or infer solvency from missing data.

name: Used business vehicle pre-check
description: Compare a Dutch vehicle and its seller with official records.
checks: RDW make, model and technical details
limitations: RDW does not identify the owner or prove the seller owns the vehicle.
No accident history, mechanical inspection, mileage guarantee or separate fuel/emissions dataset is included.
output: A comparison of the advertisement and RDW vehicle data, plus seller registration and website signals.
answer_instructions: Return a report comparing the advertisement with RDW fields, seller registration details and domain signals. Highlight discrepancies and unknowns without declaring the vehicle safe to buy.

name: Company news and events brief
description: Combine company news, sentiment and corporate events.

fields.label: Full CityFALCON ticker
fields.help: Use the full ticker including market suffix, such as AAPL_US.

limitations: CityFALCON uses a recent 30-day API window and bounded pages.
Reuters search can be loosely matched and lack dates.
Sentiment is a source-derived signal, not an investment recommendation.
output: A company briefing with dated news, reported sentiment, investor events, and available insider records.
answer_instructions: Return a dated company briefing with key developments, reported sentiment, investor events, selected insider records and source links. Separate broad market context and exclude unrelated name matches.

fields.label: Company name

fields.label: Company registration number
fields.help: Use the national registration identifier, preserving leading zeros. KVK: 8 digits; UK: 8 characters; France: 9-digit SIREN.

checks: Discrepancies with the supplied company name
Available filings, reporting periods and source limitations
limitations: Screening uses the company name returned by the registered profile, with the selected country as a matching hint. Review any discrepancy with the supplied label.
Only the named company is screened. Officers, owners and subsidiaries are not individually screened.
No match is not a compliance certification. Missing financial records do not prove non-filing, inactivity or solvency.
A filing index or deposit reference is not a downloaded document. Availability varies by country, entity and reporting period.

Preserve national identifiers, source URLs, observation dates, reporting periods and currency. Screening uses the registry-returned name. Highlight discrepancies between the supplied label and the registered name. Never turn missing data into a passed check or filing metadata into document contents.

name: Tender counterparty dossier
description: Check one tender buyer or supplier: official notice links, registered identity, screening and available filings.

fields.label: Company name
fields.help: Use the legal name associated with this registration number. A mismatch must be reviewed.

fields.label: Company registration number
fields.help: Use the national registration identifier, preserving leading zeros. KVK: 8 digits; UK: 8 characters; France: 9-digit SIREN.

checks: Discrepancies with the supplied company name
Available filings, reporting periods and source limitations
Buyer/winner role only where explicitly reported
Notice identifier, publication date, link and identity-match basis
limitations: Screening uses the company name returned by the registered profile, with the selected country as a matching hint. Review any discrepancy with the supplied label.
Only the named company is screened. Officers, owners and subsidiaries are not individually screened.
No match is not a compliance certification. Missing financial records do not prove non-filing, inactivity or solvency.
A filing index or deposit reference is not a downloaded document. Availability varies by country, entity and reporting period.
Coverage is currently NL and FR counterparties. European notices do not imply all-country counterparty coverage.
TenderNed name mentions and TED identifier matches are candidates. They do not confirm a legal-entity link, award, revenue or complete procurement history.
This checks one supplied counterparty. It does not automatically screen every company in a tender search. Bounded source pages may omit records.
output: A counterparty dossier connecting notice candidates with registered identity, company screening and available filings, while separating confirmed facts from unresolved links.
answer_instructions: Return sections for registered identity, identity discrepancies, company screening, available filings and coverage gaps. Preserve national identifiers, source URLs, observation dates, reporting periods and currency. Screening uses the registry-returned name. Highlight discrepancies between the supplied label and the registered name. Never turn missing data into a passed check or filing metadata into document contents. Add procurement records with notice link, identifier, date, role and match basis. Keep name-only matches, numeric identifier matches and source-asserted links distinct. Only report an award or amount when explicitly supported by the notice, preserving lot, currency and date; never sum notice values into company revenue.
